desc: The RM1C challenges the standard for striker-fired compact pistols. Sporting high-level details the RM1C features a hammer-forged barrel; aggressive front and rear slide serrations; ambidextrous mag release; non-glare top slide serrations combat eye fatigue and allow for quicker sight picture clarity; three slot Picatinny rail; signature RGT grip; Optic-ready with a metal RMR plate for enhanced ease of rounds on target. The RM1C accepts all other popular optic footprints and the additional metal plates for the most popular red dot sights will be available on the Rost Martin website. Tenifer treated slide provides anti-corrosion properties and is ultra durable, fighting against wear and tear and varying weather conditions.
